research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Tact.ai is researching remote realtime interactive network conferencing, focusing on systems that include a remote server and a presenter interface. The described system loads presentation material in a content renderer at the server and transmits video streams of the material to remote participants, supporting interactive customer engagement. This work highlights Tact.ai’s development in network conferencing and interactive presentation delivery.

overview_description.description: Tact.ai is on a mission to help life science organizations nurture meaningful customer engagement through our human-friendly software. Our AI-powered engagement platform empowers field teams to work with their customers in new ways to drive better outcomes. Tact.ai is headquartered in Silicon Valley and is backed by some of the world’s leading firms in venture capital, technology, and healthcare and life sciences, including Microsoft’s venture fund M12, Salesforce Ventures, Novartis, Lilly and McKesson Ventures. Visit us at: https://www.tact.ai/
